vol_rle_volume — 3D rle_region op

• Data kinds: rle_region → measurement

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_rle_volume(region) -> 'int' (to call the implementation directly, import volregion; volregion.vol_rle_volume(region) -> 'int'; from the registry, ops3d.get("vol_rle_volume"))

Usage

Voxel count of the region, computed on the runs (no decode). Measured

~300x faster than summing the dense mask.

Computation: sum(ends - starts) (the differences are taken in int64, so it does not overflow even with many runs). The return value is a Python int (voxel count, unit = voxel. If you want physical volume in mm^3, multiply by the spacing product sz*sy*sx yourself — this op does not accept spacing).

The input is validated with _require_rle before use (not a VolRLE, inconsistent shape or run arrays, out-of-range runs raise ValueError). An empty region returns 0 (not treated as an error). The purpose is to return the same value as vol_rle_decode followed by sum(), without building a dense array. Applying it to each component of vol_rle_components gives the per-component volume.
